$comment: Free listing pages fetched directly (no search index between us and the links). Each entry is a page whose server-rendered markup links watchable livestreams: scripts/run_daily.py's DirectListBackend fetches it with stdlib urllib and keeps only links with a live/basketball signal in the URL or anchor text. Add a page here (and a probe in tests/fixtures/ if it is load-bearing) rather than hard-coding a URL into the backend. Verified fetchable 2026-11-13 and re-verified 2026-11-16 with the runtime user agent via plain GET: mdr.de/sport/livestreams (200, 7 stream links) and sportschau.de/basketball (200, ~13 stream links) plus dyn.sport/deinsender/dyn-sport-mix/ (200, 2 free-tier live links: Pluto TV live-tv and Prime Video livetv), ardmediathek.de/live (200, 20 live channel links), zdf.de/sport (200, 7 sport live links), rbb24.de/sport/livestreams.html (200, 5 livestream links) and br.de/nachrichten/sport (200, 8 live links incl. BR24Sport live). All hosts are approved sources (Tier 2/3/4); basketball relevance is decided per link by the 7-check pipeline, not by the listing.
